name: sitedesk
description: 临床中心台 SiteDesk — CRO/SMO 运营管理系统

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sitedesk/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sitedesk/policy && npm run typecheck -w @sitedesk/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w db && npm run test -w @sitedesk/contracts && npm run test -w @sitedesk/policy && npm run test -w @sitedesk/api
scripts.api:dev: npm run build -w @sitedesk/api && npm run start -w @sitedesk/api
